{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_msb256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_enable;
        wire [15:0] group_selected;
        wire [15:0] code_plane [3:0];
        wire [255:0] winner;
        genvar g, j, b;

        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] x;
            wire [15:0] local_winner;
            wire [3:0] local_code;
            assign x = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;
            if (g == 15) begin : top_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : lower_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : local_bits
                if (j == 15) begin : top_bit
                    assign local_winner[j] = x[j];
                end else begin : lower_bit
                    assign local_winner[j] = x[j] & ~(|x[15:j+1]);
                end
                assign winner[g*16+j] = local_winner[j] & group_enable[g];
            end

            assign local_code[0] = |(local_winner & 16'hAAAA);
            assign local_code[1] = |(local_winner & 16'hCCCC);
            assign local_code[2] = |(local_winner & 16'hF0F0);
            assign local_code[3] = |(local_winner & 16'hFF00);
            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_planes
                assign code_plane[b][g] = local_code[b] & group_enable[g];
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
        assign output_encoded[0] = |code_plane[0];
        assign output_encoded[1] = |code_plane[1];
        assign output_encoded[2] = |code_plane[2];
        assign output_encoded[3] = |code_plane[3];
        assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_selected & 16'hAAAA);
        assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_selected & 16'hCCCC);
        assign output_encoded[6] = |(group_selected & 16'hF0F0);
        assign output_encoded[7] = |(group_selected & 16'hFF00);
        assign output_unencoded[255:1] = winner[255:1];
        assign output_unencoded[0] = ~(|input_unencoded[255:1]);
    end else begin : generic_tree
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : pairs
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_pair
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb_pair
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : nodes
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_node
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb_node
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline computes a binary priority index through a selection tree and then decodes that index into 256 output bits. This puts priority selection, heavily loaded encoded signals, and decoding on the same critical path.",
  "rewrite": "For the fixed instance, use sixteen 16-bit groups with parallel higher-priority exclusion reductions. Generate one-hot outputs directly from local winners and group enables, independently of the encoded outputs. Form the binary index using local one-hot reductions and group-level selection. Retain the original tree behavior as the fallback for other parameter settings.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The direct one-hot path eliminates the encode-then-decode dependency responsible for the reported 2.60 ns path. A timing improvement is expected, but its magnitude and the new critical endpoint require the specified mapping and STA flow; no candidate timing results have been measured.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds explicit local winner and group-exclusion logic while removing the fixed instance's binary-to-one-hot decoder and encoded-index mux tree. Hierarchical encoding limits wide reduction duplication. Compliance with the 8862.124480 um^2 area cap and zero electrical violations remains unverified without mapping and electrical checks.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Pure combinational Verilog-2001 with unchanged module interface, parameter defaults, widths, and parameter declarations. In the optimized instance, the highest asserted input wins. For the all-zero input, output_valid is zero, output_encoded is zero, and output_unencoded is 256'b1, matching the original unqualified shift. Other parameter settings use the original tree equations, including their padding, truncation, priority, and default behavior. No input restrictions, storage, clocks, or external dependencies are introduced. Mapped equivalence has not been run."
}
